title: Eden Encore P1/P2 finite host exit contract
scope: Exactly H01-H07 and G01-G10; optional unsupported SDK forms are recorded as explicit exclusions, never silently accepted.
limitations: A host exit does not establish PS5 framebuffer, game compatibility or Vulkan performance; those are P5.
mandatory_workflows: NS2 standalone graphics SPIR-V qualification (main only)

items.title: NSO/ExeFS/NPDM load and process handoff
items.positive: Valid NPDM, content and executable produce a correctly bounded KProcess handoff.
items.negative: Malformed NPDM, NSO and missing content reject without partially publishing a process.
items.blocker: Await a positive and negative real-owner/real-SPIR-V witness on a single qualified engine/vendor pair.

items.title: 49-bit GMMU and NVMap transactional mappings
items.positive: 4K and sparse mappings publish only after committed VA and NVMap ownership.
items.negative: OOM, bad alignment, stale FD and remap overlap roll back without pins or PTE leaks.
items.blocker: Await a positive and negative real-owner/real-SPIR-V witness on a single qualified engine/vendor pair.

items.title: TIPC 214/216 4K and 64K sparse contract
items.positive: Real 214 region and 216 remap preserve 4K/64K granularity from authenticated reservation.
items.negative: Unknown page shift, partial 64K remap and wrong address-space owner are refused.
items.blocker: Await a positive and negative real-owner/real-SPIR-V witness on a single qualified engine/vendor pair.

items.title: VI2 graphics supervisor and display capabilities
items.positive: VI2 surface/handle and max-resolution response match live service state.
items.negative: Invalid client, retired handles and OOM cannot create fake display or signal.
items.blocker: Await a positive and negative real-owner/real-SPIR-V witness on a single qualified engine/vendor pair.

items.title: Decoder EOS, images and fences
items.positive: Valid stream, frame ownership and EOS advance output only after actual decoded pixels.
items.negative: Invalid codec, unmet release fences and allocation failures retain ownership and do not advance guest fences.
items.blocker: Await a positive and negative real-owner/real-SPIR-V witness on a single qualified engine/vendor pair.

items.title: GPU IPC/TIPC command and handle ABI

items.negative: Unknown commands, stale FD and unauthorized process cannot produce success or mutate mappings.
